event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Defensives led, tech bled. Sept existing home sales collapsed -7.3% vs -0.50% fc alongside housing starts 122.1 vs 130.5, yet XLV +2.37% and XLRE +1.70% rallied on rate-cut hope and XLF +1.20% absorbed it — the tape is rotating out of growth into defensives and rate-sensitives, not pricing recession. QQQ -0.10% and SOXX -0.38% confirm the high-to-low unwind.

INDICES — VIX 17.3, above its 16.1 20-day MA. IWM +1.66%, DIA +1.05%, SPY +0.34%, QQQ -0.10%, SOXX -0.38%. Small > large by 1.32pp. Biggest cross-asset move: TLT +0.84% and SLV +1.13% while UUP -0.34% and GLD -0.54%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 0.8x with price +0.34% = low-conviction drift; QQQ 0.8x with price -0.10% = quiet fade, not distribution. SOXX 1.3x with price -0.38% is the one real distribution print. Breadth is bullish underneath: 388/112 advancers, 2.20 up/down volume, 46 new highs vs 12 lows, but only 51% above the 50-DMA — participation confirms the rally's breadth while the mega-cap index lags.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +2.37%, XLRE Real Estate +1.70%, XLU Utilities +1.26%, XLF Financials +1.20%, XLY Discretionary +0.91%, XLP Staples +0.62%, XLB Materials +0.55%, XLE Energy +0.25%, XLC Comms +0.09%, XLI Industrials +0.07%, XLK Technology -0.28%. Top industries: MSOS +4.72%, XBI +3.64%; bottom: XME -1.01%, DRAM -1.26%. Flows confirm: XLV +$367mm (85p) and XLE +$406mm (73p) in, while XLK bleeds -$235mm (15p). Money is moving into healthcare and energy, out of tech and financials — 'high-to-low rotation'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.41 and skew +6.5% show heavy protection demand into a flat tape; QQQ skew +10.7% is fatter still. VIXEQ 41.2 vs VIX 17.3 is a wide gap — high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape, not a correlated macro move.

CROSS-ASSET — TLT +0.84% and GLD -0.54% with UUP -0.34% is the coherent signal: a softer dollar and lower yields despite the housing miss, silver +1.13% riding it. Next FOMC Oct 28; CME FedWatch shows 100% hike odds.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 61.3, Greed. Movers: MSCI +5.00% on a valuation note, NOC +4.57% on Q3 results, WDAY +4.50% on a stake buy. Watch: GE -3.67% on 2.3x volume (distribution), IWM +1.66% on 1.0x volume (breadth confirmation), MSCI on 2.5x volume (follow-through).
